member.name: T:Tracto.Contract.Validation.CapabilityDigestCalculator
member.summary: Computes and verifies the capabilityDigest for a WorkerRegistration (C4 APPROVED). The digest is an INTEGRITY HINT ONLY — not authentication proof (ST1-09-AC03). Calculation: SHA-256( workerId + runtimeType + workerVersion + canonicalized(advertisedCapabilities) ) Canonical form: UTF-8 JSON with actionNamespaces and predicateNamespaces arrays sorted alphabetically.

member.summary: Computes the expected digest for the given registration fields. Returns the digest in the format "sha256:<hex>".

member.name: M:Tracto.Contract.Validation.CapabilityDigestCalculator.Verify(Tracto.Contract.Models.Protocol.WorkerRegistration)
member.summary: Verifies that the registration's capabilityDigest matches the computed expected value. Returns (isMatch, expected). The Orchestrator uses this to detect accidental mutation. IMPORTANT: A digest mismatch is a warning, not a security gate. Authentication is via mTLS/token, not the digest.
